name: agy-image
description: Generate and edit images from Claude desktop chat through your own logged-in Antigravity CLI (agy).
long_description: Runs the agy CLI on your computer to generate or edit images, saves them to ~/Pictures/agy-images, and shows them in chat. You must install the Antigravity CLI and sign in by running `agy` in a terminal first. The extension has no account or key of its own and never reads your credentials. Every image spends your own agy image quota.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the agy models your account can use.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit images with your logged-in agy CLI.

agy_path.title: Path to agy (optional)
agy_path.description: Leave empty to find agy automatically. Set it only if the extension reports that agy was not found, for example /Users/your-name/.local/bin/agy.
